text: BAM's share of Solana stake eased to 29.2% (126.8M SOL) over the past 26 hours. Just 2 of the 13 live nodes hold a majority of marketplace stake, with the largest at 28.7% and 91 validators concentrated on the busiest node in fra. The top node by stake changed hands 69 times in this window — whale-driven routing, not structural rollovers.
